description: Header file defining AccessControlList class for managing access control policies, including nested classes for JSON serialization, filtering, and role management.

classes.name: AccessControlList
classes.description: Main class for managing access control policies, roles, and URL filtering.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL
classes.description: JSON serializable container for ACL configuration, including groups, roles, and plugins.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins
classes.description: Container for plugin rules, including default mode and methods.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Plugins::Rules
classes.description: Defines rules for a plugin, including default mode and allowed methods.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Roles
classes.description: Container for roles, mapping role names to plugin rules.

classes.name: AccessControlList::JSONACL::Group
classes.description: Represents a URL and associated role for access control.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter
classes.description: Filters access based on plugin rules and regex matching for callsign and method.

classes.name: AccessControlList::Filter::Plugin
classes.description: Represents a plugin's allowed methods and default blocking mode.

methods.name: CreateRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern from input string, replacing wildcards.

methods.name: CreateUrlRegex
methods.description: Creates a regex pattern for URLs from input string, escaping special characters.

methods.name: Filter::Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a method is allowed for a plugin based on rules.

methods.name: Filter::Allowed
methods.description: Checks if a call with specific callsign and method is permitted.

methods.name: AccessControlList::FilterMapFromURL
methods.description: Retrieves filter rules matching a given URL.

methods.name: AccessControlList::Load
methods.description: Loads ACL configuration from a file and parses roles, groups, and rules.
